messages:
olivia_chen: heads-up — multiple tenants reporting ~3h gaps in the Console hourly usage charts since ~01:15 UTC (aurora-llc, bytecart, and neo-shop). dashboards show missing windows rather than zeros.

ramon_diaz: noticed alert: consumer group `usage-aggregator` consumer lags exploding around 01:12. group rebalance around 01:10 followed by long commit stalls. grabbing consumer logs.

miles_ng: quick check: `kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --describe --group usage-aggregator` shows LAG >> 1M on partitions 2,5,9. Also seeing repeated `CommitFailedException` in app logs.

ramon_diaz: consumer logs indicate a Debezium CDC connector tombstone spike earlier — looks like source connector restarted and produced out-of-order offsets; aggregator attempted to catch up and hit write contention on rollup DB (pg-writer).

lena_kim: support triage: are customer-facing values affected (billing)? or just console visualizations?

priyanka_shah: only console/analytics UI so far — billing pipeline unaffected. customers complaining about missing recent hours in charts. PR to support with a short note ready once we know ETA.

miles_ng: mitigation plan: 1) stop live aggregator consumers for partitions [2,5,9] to avoid duplicate writes; 2) run replay job `agg-replay-216` to backfill hourly aggregates from CDC snapshots; 3) rate-limit writes to 600 rows/s to avoid DB tail-latency. starting step 1 now.

devops-bot: Action logged — job request `agg-replay-216` queued by miles_ng.

ramon_diaz: we've paused aggregator pods for affected partitions. starting controlled replay against backup topic `usage-hourly-replay`. note: this will take ~2.5-4h depending on DB retries.

miles_ng: command I used to inspect commit offsets:
```
kafka-run-class.sh kafka.tools.ExportZkOffsets --topic usage-hourly --zkconnect zookeeper.prod:2181
# compare with consumer group offsets
```

lena_kim: draft support update: "We're investigating missing hourly metrics for some tenants; engineers identified a consumer replay and are backfilling the missing hours. Charts should re-populate as backfill completes. ETA ~3h. We'll send updates at 25%/75%/100%." Approve?

priyanka_shah: approve. add: "no billing impact" and link to status page.

miles_ng: 25% complete. replay job throttled to protect primary writer; DB p99 write time spiking if we go faster.

ramon_diaz: note to infra: create alert for repeated Debezium connector restarts + consumer rebalance frequency (INF-3033). also add runbook step to check CDC tombstone flood handling.

olivia_chen: customers notified via support thread and status page. will post 25% update.

devops-bot: Incident created by support-bot — INC-2026-233 (Delayed hourly aggregates). Severity: P2. Link: https://status.redwood.dev/incidents/INC-2026-233

miles_ng: mid-run check: replay job hit a batch with malformed record (null tenant_id) — skipping those records and logging them to `agg-replay-errors/216`. continuing.

priyanka_shah: thanks, please capture sample row ids for support to include in follow-ups.

ramon_diaz: 75% complete. partitions 2 & 5 done; processing 9 now. visibility in Console improving for sample tenants.

lena_kim: sending 75% customer update now. customers asking for raw row timestamps — sharing a sanitized snippet per privacy guidance.

miles_ng: replay finished. ran verifier script against hourly_rollups table for a random tenant set; counts matched expected windows.

ramon_diaz: follow-ups assigned: INF-3033 (infra alert + runbook), ENG-4120 (consumer resilience: handle CDC offset jumps), and a small schema check to reject tombstones earlier.

olivia_chen: closing customer comms in 30m if no regressions. postmortem draft started.

support-bot: Incident INC-2026-233 updated to Resolved — root cause: CDC connector restart causing offset reordering and consumer rebalance which stalled aggregator consumption; mitigated via paused consumers + controlled replay.

priyanka_shah: closing message sent to customers and thread archived. thanks team. :tada:
